name: mcp-doctor
description: mcp-doctor: lint and fix MCP servers from inside Claude Code

plugins.name: mcp-doctor
plugins.description: Lint the MCP server you're building for what breaks the agent calling it, then fix what it finds. Python, TypeScript and Go.

plugins.name: mcp-doctor-guard
plugins.description: Guard Claude Code's own tools: hold a secret about to be sent out, or a write to .git hooks/config or shell rc files, after the session read outside content.
